Game Introduction

Attention, players:
Certain sensitive, risqué scenes have been removed, which may cause some story transitions to feel a bit disjointed.
The ranking page has not been developed yet and is not available!

Welcome to “Summer Homestay”!
College student Li Lei, in pursuit of internship credits, unexpectedly finds himself working as a summer helper at a seaside guesthouse. What seemed like an ordinary part-time job quickly spirals into a lively comedy as he encounters four very different female lodgers—a strict English teacher, a childhood friend, a mischievous girl, and a tsundere heiress. From hilarious misunderstandings to intense cooking showdowns, get ready for a chaotic yet heart-warming summer rom-com adventure!

Four Heroines

  • Han Meimei｜The Gap-Moe Teacher
    Comedy setup: Outwardly a serious and strict English tutor, but in reality a hopeless disaster in everyday life.

  • Xiaomei｜Straightforward Childhood Friend on the Rampage
    Comedy setup: Self-proclaimed “sweet but not dumb girl of the guesthouse.”

  • Chana｜The Little Devil Cosplay Master
    Comedy setup: Loves taking photos with the player, her catchphrase is “Li Lei, you big dummy!” and she has an unusual passion for insect cuisine.

  • Liuli｜The Tsundere Heiress
    Comedy setup: Arrives with a whole arsenal, declaring she wants to “experience commoner life.” She even orders the player to use “superpowers” when chopping vegetables.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7950
  • Storage: 24 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent or above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7950
  • Storage: 24 GB available space

short_description: "Play a lighthearted interactive movie game as college student Li Lei! Spend a summer at Ms. Han's B&B with 4 quirky friends. Enjoy hilarious bonding, secret crushes, and unforgettable memories under the sun!"
supported_languages:
Simplified Chinese*, English
*languages with full audio support
